TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT NARRATIVE
AND PLANS
4518 W. Lawrence Ave

The Applicant seeks to rezone 4518 W. Lawrence Avenue from a C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial
District to a C1-3 Neighborhood Commercial District in order to construct a three-story mixed-
use building with approximately 2,576 square feet of ground-floor commercial space, six (6)
residential dwelling units, and three (3) vehicular parking spaces. The proposed mixed-use
building will have a height of approximately 35 feet. The existing one-story commercial building
will be demolished.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as
allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.
